original.title: EPS SWC Architecture
original.description: SWC_ElectricPowerSteering shall be implemented as an AUTOSAR ApplicationSwComponentType allocated to the EPS application partition on ECU_EPS_Main. The SWC shall own the runnables RE_Initialize (startup event), RE_ControlTorque (5 ms timing event), RE_MonitorSafety (10 ms timing event), RE_HandleModeChange (DataReceivedEvent on RP_IgnitionStatus), and RE_DiagnosticUpdate (diagnostic event). The SWC shall read VehicleSpeed, IgnitionStatus, YawRate, TorqueSensorPrimary, TorqueSensorSecondary, and MotorTemperature through required ports RP_VehicleSpeed, RP_IgnitionStatus, RP_YawRate, RP_TorqueSensorPrimary, RP_TorqueSensorSecondary, and RP_MotorTemperature. The SWC shall publish MotorCurrentDemand, EPSStatus, and AssistLevel through provided ports PP_MotorCurrentDemand, PP_EPSStatus, and PP_AssistLevel. During ACTIVE mode the architecture shall execute torque calculation every 5 ms and safety supervision every 10 ms; during FAIL_SAFE mode it shall clamp MotorCurrentDemand to 14 A maximum (20 percent of 70 A rated current) and report the active DTC through DEM within one 10 ms monitoring cycle.
